relationships.subject: caveolar transcytosis
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, caveolar transcytosis is at least partly required for monitoring of the vasculature by DRG macrophages.

key_findings: DRG vasculature shows arteriovenous zonation of permeability, with CLDN5-PLVAP+ venous capillaries and veins most permeable.
Caveolar transcytosis is partly required for perivascular macrophage uptake of blood-borne macromolecules at the blood-DRG barrier.
